title: Save time and get context!
text: Great way to tour both the Cathedral and Alkazar. Skipping the line saves time and you get context you wont get just seeing these two beautiful sites.
author: Paul_A

title: Wonderful time and we...
text: Wonderful time and we learned so much from our guide. Climbing the bell tower is work but so worth it. Just be prepared!  Seeing the Alcazr was also very informative and relaxing.
author: Geoff_T

title: excellent visit to Seville Cathedral
text: We visited the Cathedral of Seville with Jesus, it is not a miracle but the name of our excellent guide who knew how to share his knowledge and passion for this monument and the city of Seville in general. Thanks to it we discovered other sites that we could also enjoy.
author: patrick r

title: These are iconic...
text: These are iconic buildings and are a must if you visit Seville.  The audio headsets are useful when you are on the tour.
author: Scott_P

title: Interesting and informative guided tour in German
text: Thank you for the informative, friendly and interesting guided tour of the Alcazar and the Cathedral in German by Mrs. Carmen P.

title: Definitely worth visiting
text: The cathedral and the Alkazar were absolutely worth visiting. Our guide, Jesus was very knowledgeable, enjoyable, and really made the visit worthwhile.
author: jayneb395

title: Amazing architecture
text: The cathedral was amazing and alcazar is super cool, especially if you've seen Game of Thrones. Our house was very informative although hard to keep track of in the things of people. If seeing but places, plan on a good 3 hours. We didn't realize it would be that long.
author: Heather_C

title: Visit Alcazar and Cathedral
text: Our Guide Jesus introduced us to the Alcazar and the Cathedral with lots of exciting information about the history of Seville but not that;-) . The visit was rhythmic, interesting and funny.  Thank you, Jesus.
